text.english: I don't want to come back to this home anymore.

text.chinese: 您不是总说我们可以进行一些
text.english: You always say that we can do some

text.chinese: 不过幸好有我在一招之敌
text.english: Fortunately, I am your worthy opponent.

text.chinese: 我真想破镜给你抓起来
text.english: I really want to break a mirror and grab you.

text.chinese: 就算你不提张白也饶不了我的
text.english: Even if you don't mention it, Zhang Bai can't spare me.

text.chinese: 但是有一点可以肯定他绝对撒谎了
text.english: But one thing is certain, he definitely lied.

text.chinese: 末将率少纪前往五丈原探查
text.english: The general will lead a small group to explore Wuzhangyuan.

text.chinese: 不是你为什么要辞职
text.english: Why did you resign?

text.chinese: 侯亮平确实是被诬陷
text.english: Hou Liangping was indeed framed.

text.chinese: 从山没来上学啊到今天已经是第三天了三天啊三天了
text.english: From the mountain to school, it has already been the third day, three days, three days.

text.chinese: 可有证据无需证据
text.english: Evidence is optional

text.chinese: 这个莫玄宇到底做了什么呀
text.english: What did this Mo Xuan Yu do?

text.chinese: 我就觉得他最近好像有什么事瞒着我
text.english: I feel like he's hiding something from me recently.

text.chinese: 对不起刚才说态度不好
text.english: I'm sorry for my bad attitude just now.

text.chinese: 你知道七连多少次从石山血海中爬起来
text.english: Do you know how many times Qilian has climbed out of the sea of blood from Shishan?

text.chinese: 老范暂时不能拿他怎么样
text.english: Mr. Fan cannot do anything to him temporarily.

text.chinese: 就是有个人跟我说他不是真正生我气
text.english: Someone just told me that they are not really mad at me.

text.chinese: 那是因为太子已然不值得考虑了
text.english: That's because the prince is no longer worth considering.

text.chinese: 白白没有了的孩子在伤心呢
text.english: The child without Bai Bai is sad.

text.chinese: 齐副局长想请您去一趟他的办公室
text.english: Deputy Director Qi would like to invite you to his office.

text.chinese: 我只能把自己出卖给邪恶了
text.english: I can only sell myself to evil.

text.chinese: 好继续论证
text.english: Good, continue to argue.

text.chinese: 光靠殿下的一腔热血是不行的
text.english: Relying solely on Your Highness's passion is not enough.

text.chinese: 既然是老朋友在下有一事相求
text.english: Since we are old friends, I have a favor to ask.

text.chinese: 没有拜帖不得入内
text.english: No invitation, no entry.

text.chinese: 大嘴你没事吧
text.english: Are you okay, Dazui?

text.chinese: 我就选择了你所有的一切
text.english: I have chosen everything about you

text.chinese: 我还就不退了看你能把我怎么着
text.english: I won't back down, let's see what you can do to me.

text.chinese: 这二处是为国家引忧
text.english: These two places are causing concerns for the country.

text.chinese: 还要把那些亲属全部都公布出来好让有些人有事没事去个律所去个学校什么的要挟他
text.english: I also want to disclose all those relatives so that some people can go to a law firm or school to threaten him for no reason.

text.chinese: 有什么需求尽管开口
text.english: Feel free to speak up if you have any needs.

text.chinese: 我就承认吧我就是怂了
text.english: I admit it, I'm scared.

text.chinese: 半夜三更的你是要把整条街的人都吵醒了吗
text.english: Are you trying to wake up the whole street in the middle of the night?

text.chinese: 你我都要去扶黄泉
text.english: Both you and I have to go to the Yellow Springs.

text.chinese: 在苏家呼风唤雨
text.english: Command the wind and rain at the Su's residence.

text.chinese: 和几个顶尖的乐师来助导我的府上他们献血出来的
text.english: Several top musicians came to assist in conducting at my residence, they donated blood.

text.chinese: 咱们这是加强防护您带上吧
text.english: Let's strengthen the protection, please put it on.

text.chinese: 坂田这个兔崽子我非砸碎了他不可
text.english: I must smash this brat Sakata

text.chinese: 可自师父他老人家去世后
text.english: After the passing of my master

text.chinese: 你总是念着阿娘受过的苦
text.english: You always remember the hardships your mother has endured.

text.chinese: 一直都是殿下的心啊
text.english: Always the heart of Your Highness

text.chinese: 就算靖王要来看你
text.english: Even if King Jing wants to come and see you.

text.chinese: 赶紧走吧不如我叫你
text.english: Hurry up and leave, I'd rather call you.

text.chinese: 则吴军是刻意来云梦规劝于我的
text.english: Ze Jun Wu deliberately came to Yunmeng to persuade me.

text.chinese: 不但要完善这个社会制度要完善我们的自身和理论
text.english: Not only do we need to improve the social system, but we also need to improve ourselves and our theories.

text.chinese: 有个朋友来聊聊天也挺好的
text.english: It's also nice to have a friend to chat with.

text.chinese: 还有什么樱桃碧螺
text.english: What else do you have, cherry and abalone

text.chinese: 这郎中是第一次医治死病若无完全把握
text.english: This is the first time this doctor has treated a terminal illness without complete confidence.

text.chinese: 他怎可一人反穷谁来保护他的安危
text.english: How can he be alone against poverty? Who will protect his safety?

text.chinese: 松泽民是怕杨柳枕他
text.english: Song Zemin is afraid that Yang Liu will pillow him.

text.chinese: 我怎么没事干了
text.english: What am I supposed to do now?

text.chinese: 我看你这个人哪挺聪明的
text.english: I think you are quite smart.

text.chinese: 去寒底补普听我言要不然不会有今天
text.english: Go to the bottom of the cold and listen to what I say, otherwise we wouldn't have today.

text.chinese: 可能会充满荆棘
text.english: May be full of thorns

text.chinese: 吃喝玩乐耍
text.english: Eat, drink, play, have fun

text.chinese: 您的问题我回答了
text.english: I answered your question.

text.chinese: 敢问是哪
text.english: May I ask who you are?

text.chinese: 这其二自然是
text.english: This is the second nature.

text.chinese: 为万物之表取生灵之气
text.english: To take the breath of life from all things.

text.chinese: 不是急我就是我我当时脑子短路了没你别笑了那接下来
text.english: It's not that I'm in a hurry, it's just that I was being myself. I had a momentary lapse of reason, don't laugh at me. What happens next?

text.chinese: 觉着不是一个人干的
text.english: I don't think it was done by one person.

text.chinese: 再不走可真要挨打了
text.english: If you don't leave now, you will really get beaten.

text.chinese: 罗川你别这么说啊
text.english: Luo Chuan, don't say that.

text.chinese: 都是自己人误会是个误会
text.english: It's a misunderstanding among ourselves.

text.chinese: 他还死战不降呢
text.english: He is still fighting to the death and refuses to surrender.

text.chinese: 且被流失期给杀了
text.english: And be killed by the lost period

text.chinese: 你这么帮他不是爱他是害他
text.english: You are not loving him by helping him like this, you are harming him.

text.chinese: 项文随我入秦
text.english: Xiang Wensui, follow me to Qin.

text.chinese: 自然了日久见人心
text.english: Time reveals true nature.

text.chinese: 你得跟我说实话呀
text.english: You have to tell me the truth.

text.chinese: 但是在夏荷的事情上朕的心里有点不以为然
text.english: But I am a little skeptical about Xiahe's matter in my heart.

text.chinese: 我父王功盖还宇名满天下
text.english: My father's achievements cover the universe and his name is renowned throughout the world.

text.chinese: 康熙十五年我们一起去兴秀海勘察测量
text.english: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi, we went together to Xingxiu Sea for surveying and mapping.

text.chinese: 我孙老师调职舞再休息啊
text.english: My teacher Sun is transferred, let's take a break and dance.

text.chinese: 就算是功心显著
text.english: Even if the merit is remarkable

text.chinese: 穆老师我说句心里话啊我就不能想我那一
text.english: Teacher Mu, let me speak from my heart, I can't help but think of my past.

text.chinese: 走吧咱们做任务去走
text.english: Let's go, let's go on a mission.

text.chinese: 必将命丧紫禁城
text.english: Will definitely die in the Forbidden City

text.chinese: 张超对杀害江洋的整起案件
text.english: Zhang Chao is responsible for the entire case of killing Jiang Yang.

text.chinese: 这两千军士已经无助于
text.english: These two thousand soldiers are already helpless.

text.chinese: 打在长征卡上的两千万你可是担保人
text.english: You are the guarantor for the 20 million yuan printed on the Long March card.

text.chinese: 我当时甚至都想跳车了
text.english: I even wanted to jump off the car at that time.

text.chinese: 拿你的后半辈子来献祭
text.english: Sacrifice your remaining life for you

text.chinese: 你也真是的怎么买错票了
text.english: You are really something, how did you buy the wrong ticket?

text.chinese: 我想你干脆把她娶到来反正不是外人
text.english: I want you to just marry her anyway, she's not an outsider.

text.chinese: 你得在我那单峰火柴茶路
text.english: You have to come to my place on the Single Peak Matcha Tea Road.

text.chinese: 还是别出意外才好
text.english: It's better not to have any unexpected accidents.

text.chinese: 蜀山大业并不代表可以杀死师父
text.english: The great cause of Shu Mountain does not mean that I can kill my master.

text.chinese: 我想十之八九他们还会向着周瑜毕竟人家是一家人嘛
text.english: I think most of them will still support Zhou Yu after all, they are family.

text.chinese: 一处的任务是为了保证会场安全
text.english: One of the tasks is to ensure the safety of the venue.

text.chinese: 所以我们最大的愿望就是在这里能够建一间医院再号召一些医生来这里
text.english: So our biggest wish is to build a hospital here and call on some doctors to come here.

text.chinese: 可渐渐地我变得恐惧
text.english: Gradually, I become afraid.

text.chinese: 我不需要安慰因为我不配安慰
text.english: I don't need comfort because I don't deserve it.

text.chinese: 是我们拼死相保扶他坐上皇位的皇上
text.english: The emperor who we fought to the death to protect and help him ascend to the throne.

text.chinese: 小刘问你个事
text.english: Xiao Liu has a question for you.

text.chinese: 我保证是严守不误
text.english: I promise to strictly abide by it without any mistakes.

text.chinese: 让他认清楚现实准备好赔钱哪
text.english: Let him see the reality and be prepared to lose money.

text.chinese: 是吗姓罗了妈那好那好
text.english: Is it true that your last name is Luo?

text.chinese: 爸明天我唱两首新歌你来吧
text.english: Dad, I will sing two new songs tomorrow, please come.

text.chinese: 美味方众要定期到此中祭火
text.english: Delicious food must be regularly offered to the fire here.

text.chinese: 为什么阿泽要骗我说
text.english: Why did Aze lie to me?

text.chinese: 青豆鱼鸡汤放这个罐子里
text.english: Put the green bean fish chicken soup in this jar.

text.chinese: 不是出轨就是凶杀
text.english: Either cheating or murder

text.chinese: 我自己买啊你自己多吃点
text.english: I'll buy it myself, you eat more.

text.chinese: 大白天的别胡说八道啊
text.english: Don't talk nonsense in broad daylight.

text.chinese: 在昆仑西南二千余里
text.english: Over two thousand miles southwest of Kunlun.

text.chinese: 那可太危险了你就不怕别人抢你的宝贝
text.english: That's too dangerous. Aren't you afraid of someone stealing your treasure?

text.chinese: 刚真正在外面那声尖叫你在里面听见了没有听到了
text.english: Did you hear that scream just now outside while you were inside?

text.chinese: 大舅啊
一旦下山必是死局
text.english: Once down the mountain, it will be a dead end.

text.chinese: 尤其这个事情现在又很敏感
text.english: Especially this matter is now very sensitive.

text.chinese: 踏进这个圈子不得罪人是不可能的
text.english: It is impossible to enter this circle without offending anyone.

text.chinese: 下午看见你们上山了一直没下来
text.english: In the afternoon, I saw you all go up the mountain and you never came down.

text.chinese: 你看不上我们这些山谷人家就写一份合黎书来让我走人
text.english: If you don't think highly of us valley people, then write a letter of separation for me to leave.

text.chinese: 都疯了再说现在君上
text.english: Say it again now, my lord.

text.chinese: 不知陛下可否恩准
text.english: May I ask if Your Majesty would grant permission?

text.chinese: 有徐副主任这句话
text.english: There is Deputy Director Xu's statement.

text.chinese: 这休书还请相公签了吧
text.english: Please sign this letter, my lord.

text.chinese: 皇帝倘若对宛嫔还有心结
text.english: If the emperor still has concerns about Wanfei

text.chinese: 中国人民终于站起来了
text.english: The Chinese people have finally stood up.

text.chinese: 任谁看到临安城的民不聊生的惨状
text.english: Whoever sees the miserable situation of the people in Lin'an City

text.chinese: 想想我们在围达上遇到了每一位职业棋手都实力不错
text.english: Think about how we met every professional chess player on Weida, and they all have good skills.

text.chinese: 别捧我专案组的人每个人都有付出
text.english: Everyone in my project team has made contributions, don't just praise me.

text.chinese: 这二十四家的加一项第二十五项
text.english: This is the twenty-fifth item added to these twenty-four.

text.chinese: 我们走亲戚这孩子跑不了
text.english: We are going to visit relatives, this child cannot escape.

text.chinese: 我闻到了一股浓重的个人英雄主义的味道
text.english: I smell a strong scent of individual heroism.

text.chinese: 他们死又能回来了
text.english: They can come back to life again.

text.chinese: 谁啊暂时保密
text.english: Who is it? It's temporarily confidential.

text.chinese: 你说你这一非朕的皇子
text.english: You said you are not my prince.

text.chinese: 你别跟我废话了你是不是疯了
text.english: You stop talking nonsense to me, are you crazy?

text.chinese: 但是我只能赌一把了
text.english: But I can only take a gamble.

text.chinese: 从今天开始心痛的应该只有我一个吧
text.english: From today on, the one who should feel heartache is only me.

text.chinese: 读过我之前太久走
text.english: Read before I walked too long

text.chinese: 支持北极这次收购
text.english: Support the acquisition of the Arctic this time.

text.chinese: 今日是陛下和先生的大婚之日
text.english: Today is the day of the Emperor and Mr.'s wedding.

text.chinese: 还怎么跟她说话呀不去
text.english: How can I talk to her if I don't go?

text.chinese: 你在这儿干吗呢我的鲜花饼呢
text.english: What are you doing here, my flower cake?

text.chinese: 肺腑之言
text.english: Words from the bottom of my heart

text.chinese: 不过那两幅字啊是小朋友的作品
text.english: But those two characters are the works of children.

text.chinese: 那我们可以这样派几个老师进去
text.english: How many teachers can we send in like this?

text.chinese: 黄魁和曹植也有诗文场合
text.english: Huang Kui and Cao Zhi also have occasions for poetry and literature.

text.chinese: 凶者如今还要自欺欺人吗
text.english: Does the murderer still want to deceive himself and others now?

text.chinese: 你也不用你那脑子好好想想
text.english: You don't have to use your brain to think about it.

text.chinese: 你这是说新闻哪
text.english: What news are you talking about?

text.chinese: 那你有没有做过对不起我的事啊
text.english: Have you ever done anything to hurt me?

text.chinese: 我说你不觉得这样做太小人了吗
text.english: Don't you think it's too petty of you to do this?

text.chinese: 胡景业唐海请多喜欢夸大气死你保心他
text.english: Hu Jingye, Tang Hai, please like to exaggerate and make you angry to protect his heart.

text.chinese: 我也不放走
text.english: I won't let you go either.

text.chinese: 你老跟着我们俩干吗呀
text.english: Why are you always following us?

text.chinese: 本座要忍受他乱七八糟的杂念到什么时候
text.english: How long do I have to endure his messy thoughts?

text.chinese: 那个眼瞎耳聪腿瘸臂强
text.english: That person is blind but has sharp hearing, a lame leg, and a strong arm.

text.chinese: 太子殿心愿手
text.english: Prince's palace heart wish hand

text.chinese: 一直非常感谢组织对我的认可
text.english: I am always very grateful for the organization's recognition of me.

text.chinese: 你从前做的对不起你的事
text.english: The thing you did before, I'm sorry for it.

text.chinese: 还成我跨不过去的一道坎了
text.english: I can't get over this hurdle.

text.chinese: 就是因为出院了我才担惊受怕的呀
text.english: It's just because I was discharged from the hospital that I was worried and scared.

text.chinese: 我们截回到一分钱都没捞着不合适吧
text.english: It's not appropriate for us to end up with nothing.

text.chinese: 你说得对
如果凶手是从后面突然袭击
text.english: If the killer suddenly attacks from behind.

text.chinese: 我们只有三十分钟的应对时间
text.english: We only have thirty minutes to respond.

text.chinese: 是吧我马上过来啊你等着我
text.english: Is it? I'll be right there, wait for me.

text.chinese: 这天下是皇上的天下
text.english: This world belongs to the emperor.

text.chinese: 那可使得自己一身荣华
text.english: That can make oneself full of glory.

text.chinese: 如果你还想再待几天
text.english: If you want to stay a few more days

text.chinese: 你是怕许茹归把楚楚的身世给说出来吧
text.english: Are you afraid that Xu Ru will reveal Chu Chu's background?

text.chinese: 江公子不必客气我是医师治病救人本就是本分
text.english: Jiang Gongzi, you don't have to be polite. I am a doctor, and it is my duty to treat and save people.

text.chinese: 你把这些猪狗不食的东西来为我们
text.english: You bring these inedible things for us.

text.chinese: 我就是被你坑了的人
text.english: I am the person who was deceived by you.

text.chinese: 惹皇上不快
text.english: Make the emperor unhappy

text.chinese: 镇抚司衙吗不妥
text.english: Is the yamen of the pacification commissioner inappropriate?

text.chinese: 小北啊这次循环水泵事件
text.english: Xiaobei, this time the circulating water pump incident

text.chinese: 那麻烦你先把枪打开我不喜欢人家把我当作敌人看待
text.english: That's troublesome, could you please open the gun first? I don't like being treated as an enemy by others.

text.chinese: 我把她带到这个世上光这个
text.english: I brought her into this world just for this.

text.chinese: 学校涌现出了大批的优秀人才念力的时候
text.english: A large number of outstanding talents emerged from the school when it comes to reading ability.

text.chinese: 长明同志
text.english: Comrade Changming

text.chinese: 那你打算怎么跟你师父说
text.english: How do you plan to tell your master?

text.chinese: 是当时你说的这句话
text.english: It was the sentence you said.

text.chinese: 这些情报卖给谁都是一大笔钱
text.english: Selling this information to anyone would be a big sum of money.

text.chinese: 怎能让王妃亲自动手当然是姨娘来摘了
text.english: How can I let the princess do it herself? Of course, it's the maid who will pick it.

text.chinese: 难道他背后就没有人推动吗
text.english: Is there no one behind him pushing?

text.chinese: 毕竟我需要刺激刺激那个心性不稳的萧精确来我院子里闹上一闹
text.english: After all, I need to stimulate that unstable Xiao Jingqing to come to my yard and cause some trouble.

text.chinese: 现在问题是我都睡不好觉了
text.english: The problem now is that I can't sleep well.

text.chinese: 已经换过两次药了伤口更肿更大了
text.english: I have changed the medicine twice already, but the wound has become more swollen and bigger.

text.chinese: 那我不只是小小的有点点担心你不同意吗
text.english: Am I just a little worried that you might disagree?

text.chinese: 你不是我肚子里的蛔虫吗
text.english: Aren't you the worm in my stomach?

text.chinese: 难得烂花仙子有这份心
text.english: Rarely does the Fairy of Rotten Flowers have such a heart.

text.chinese: 我就算是上了当了
text.english: Even if I have been fooled

text.chinese: 阴阳家也说北阪之下乃兴秦之圣地
text.english: Yin and yang scholars also say that the area below the north slope is the sacred land of Qin's prosperity.

text.chinese: 这叫什么拉拢辅食人的
text.english: What is this called to win over people with food?

text.chinese: 既然对双方都有好处他不妨可以试一试
text.english: Since it benefits both parties, he might as well give it a try.

text.chinese: 我这个王妹还真是莽撞啊
text.english: I, this Wang Mei, am really reckless.

text.chinese: 浮城是川东重镇而且是水陆两路码头
text.english: Fucheng is an important town in eastern Sichuan and it has both water and land terminals.

text.chinese: 可能打电话不是很方便吧
text.english: Maybe it's not very convenient to make a phone call.

text.chinese: 他还记得这个妹妹
text.english: He still remembers this sister.

text.chinese: 那还不是很清楚的吗
text.english: Isn't that very clear?

text.chinese: 所以你这段时间瞒着我
text.english: So you've been hiding this from me for a while.

text.chinese: 那既然是他说给我的
text.english: Since he said it to me.

text.chinese: 听说伤得可不轻啊
text.english: I heard you got hurt pretty badly.

text.chinese: 吞下所有苦果
text.english: Swallow all the bitter fruits.
